content:
[Hook - open]
@voice af_bella
(break 2)
Tuck it in and let the drums stand tall,
Cut the mud and let the kick come through,
Lift the beat when the lines recall,
Sit inside it, that's the move.
(break 2)

[Verse 1 - on top]
@voice bm_george
(slot auto)
I thought the voice should sit on top and tower,
More power, louder, turn it up each hour,
But the beat went sour,
Thin and hollow.
The drums are not a carpet, they're the floor,
You stand in them, not over, that's the core.

[Verse 2 - buried]
@voice am_michael
(slot 2)
I'm buried, I'm the mumble,
Fourteen under, humble,
The hats are like a jungle,
My words begin to crumble.
A whisper in the thunder,
The kick is pulling under.
Two sounds in the same cellar,
And neither one gets clearer.

[Hook]
@voice af_bella
(slot auto)
Tuck it in and let the drums stand tall,
Cut the mud and let the kick come through,
Lift the beat when the lines recall,
Sit inside it, that's the move.
(break 2)

[Verse 3 - the pocket]
@voice af_heart
Three or four decibels under, that's the pocket,
Don't mock it, lock it, tuck the voice and dock it,
Then stop.
So set the gain per style, the trap comes down,
A different sound, a different ground, same crown,
Then shelve the low end off the voice, twelve down,
Less brown, less drown, the kick can move around.
From seven over down to under two,
Comes through.
And when the hook comes back, the beat should bloom,
A lift, a little air, and back to you.
Set it by the meter, not by pride, and let it pour.

[Hook - last time]
@voice af_bella
Tuck it in and let the drums stand tall,
Cut the mud and let the kick come through,
Lift the beat when the lines recall,
Sit inside it, that's the move.
In the mix, not on it, room for all,
In the mix, not on it, room for all.
